SPICE-RPT-002 
 1
1.0 
INTRODUCTION 
 
The purpose of this document is to identify the science requirements for the SPICE Experiment 
manifested to fly on the ISS.  The science requirements are traced to the Science Requirements 
Document. 
 
2.0 
VERIFICATION CLOSURE RECORD 
 
Appendix A contains each Science Verification Sheet, which identifies the science requirement, 
verification method, and verification closure summary.  The verification summary identifies the 
SPICE project document that addresses the verification closure.  All SPICE project documents 
are under configuration control and available upon request.  This document will be updated 
periodically to reflect the closure status of the verifications. 
 
3.0 
CURRENT VERIFICATION STATUS 
 
There are 18 verification requirements.  All requirements have been closed.  One verification, 
Radiometer accuracy is not compliant.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-1
APPENDIX A – SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEETS

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-2
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION :  1 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):  
REQUIREMENT 
Round gas jet diffusion flame in a co-flowing oxidizer stream 
IMPLEMENTATION 
Configuration is that the gas flow nozzle is in the flow duct and the gas and air 
flow are in the same direction. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD: INS 
Verify via design drawings that the experiment assembly is configured such that 
the gas flow is in the same direction as the air flow. 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
Drawing 60054MAFH000 shows that the gas nozzle is inside the flow duct and 
the gas exit is in the same direction as the airflow. 
 
This has also been verified via functional testing.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-3
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION :  2 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):  
REQUIREMENT 
Experiment is to operate at ambient pressure. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
Experiment will operate in the MSG on the ISS 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD: ANALYSIS  
Verify that the MSG facility maintains ambient pressure. 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
MSFC-ICD-3270 is the Interface Control Document for SPICE in the MSG. 
The ICD states that the MSG will nominally operate at a negative pressure of 
1.3 mBar relative to ISS cabin Pressure.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-4
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION:  3 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):  
REQUIREMENT 
The ignition of the gases will be via Hot wire. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The SPICE flight hardware will contain a Hot Wire Ignitor. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD: INS 
Verify that the design drawings include a hot wire ignitor. 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
Drawing 60054MAFH060, Ignitor Assembly includes an ignitor wire, item 
H063 with part number 60054MDFH063.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-5
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION: 4 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):  
REQUIREMENT 
The Fuel Flow shall be controlled from 0 to 500 SCCM N2 equivalent flow. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The design will include a mass flow controller with the setpoint input controlled 
with a potentiometer. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD: INS 
Verify that the design drawings include a mass flow controller with the correct 
flow range capability and that the setpoint potentiometer allows the MFC to be 
set in this range. 
 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
The Flow Controller is from MKS and is Model 179A.  The specification sheet 
states an accuracy of ±1% of Full Scale and a resolution of 0.1% of Full Scale. 
 
The mass flow controller was calibrated on 2/27/08 from 0 – 500 SCCM N2.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-6
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION:  5 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):  
REQUIREMENT 
The Oxidizer Velocity range is from 5 to 50 cm/s 
 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The Oxidizer Velocity and Co-Flow Velocity are the same measurement and 
they will be measured by an Air Velocity Transducer made by TSI with Model 
number 8475.  The output is routed to an amplifier for scaling with the output 
monitored by the A/D Converter on the Tattletale board.   
 
 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD:  INS 
Verify that the Velocity Probe is capable of supporting the required range and 
accuracy.   
 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
The specification sheet for the Velocity Probe states that the velocity range is 
from 0.05 to 2.54 m/s (5 -254 cm/s) which is within the range of 5 – 50 cm/s 
required. 
 
The accuracy is stated to be ±3% of the reading ±1% of the selected range.  This 
is within the required accuracy. 
 
Inspection of the data acquired and stored in the Experiment Assembly shows 
that 4 samples per second are acquired.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-7
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION:  6 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):  
REQUIREMENT 
The burner tube nozzle diameters are manually selectable to be 0.4, 0.8, or 1.6 
mm. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The design will include the ability for the crew to replace the burner tubes on-
orbit and that hardware includes the correct nozzle diameters. 
 
 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD:  INS 
Verify that the design drawings include the burner tubes with the correct 
diameters. 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
Drawing 60054MAFH201, Component Stowage Case Assembly includes the 
0.4 mm Diameter Burner Tube, 60054MDFH034, the 0.8 mm Diameter Burner 
Tube, 60054MDFH033, and the 1.6 mm Diameter Burner Tube, 
60054MDFH032. 
 
The design of the Burner Tube is such that the tube slides on to the burner tube 
holder located in the Experiment Assembly. 
 
This operation has been demonstrated.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-8
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION: 7 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):   
REQUIREMENT 
The Flame Length shall be from 5 to 100 mm. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
A still camera and video camera as well as the scale bar in the flow duct will be 
used to measure the flame length. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD:  DEMO 
Verify that the design includes the ability to image the flame. 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
Testing has been performed that verifies images and video of the flame can be 
acquired.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-9
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION: 8 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):   
REQUIREMENT 
The fuel mass flow shall be measured with an accuracy of 10% of the reading at 
a sampling rate of 4 Hz, and over a range of 25 – 500 SCCM. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The mass flow controller provides an output signal of 0 – 5 VDC which is 
proportional to the mass flow rate.  This signal will be monitored by the A/D 
Converter on the Tattletale board. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD: TEST 
Verify that the MFC is capable of supporting the required range and accuracy.   
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
Inspection of the data acquired and stored in the Experiment Assembly shows 
that 4 samples per second are acquired. 
 
The MFC has been calibrated with a maximum error of 0.32 % of FS.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-10 
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION: 9 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):   
REQUIREMENT 
The Co-Flow Fan Voltage shall be measured with an accuracy of 10% of the 
reading, at a sampling rate of 4 Hz, and over a range of 0.5 – 12 volts. 
 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The Co-Flow Fan Voltage signal will be monitored via a voltage divider 
proportional to the voltage in the range of 0.5 to 12 VDC. This signal will be 
monitored by the A/D Converter on the Tattletale board.   
 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD: TEST 
Perform a functional test per SPICE-TST-006.  The functional test will verify 
that when the Fan Speed potentiometer is set at its lowest and highest setting 
that the measurement is not out of range and that the change is as expected. 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
The fan voltage minimum is 5.5 volts due to the safety requirement that the fan 
provide airflow at all times even when the Fan Flow Potentiometer is set to zero. 
 The measurement displayed on the video monitor and in the data ranges from 
55 to 139.  This represents 5.5 volts – 13.9 volts going to the fan. 
 
Inspection of the data acquired and stored in the Experiment Assembly shows 
that 4 samples per second are acquired.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-11 
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION:  10 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):   
REQUIREMENT 
The Co-Flow Velocity shall be measured with an accuracy of 10% of the 
reading, at a sampling rate of 4 Hz, and over a range of 5 – 50 cm/s. 
 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The Oxidizer Velocity and Co-Flow Velocity are the same measurement and 
they will be measured by an Air Velocity Transducer made by TSI with Model 
number 8475.  The output is routed to an amplifier for scaling with the output 
monitored by the A/D Converter on the Tattletale board.   
 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD:  INS 
Verify that the Velocity Probe is capable of supporting the required range and 
accuracy. 
 
If time permits the probe will be calibrated. 
 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
The specification sheet for the Velocity Probe states that the velocity range is 
from 0.05 to 2.54 m/s (5 -254 cm/s) which is within the range of 5 – 50 cm/s 
required. 
The fact that the fan is always on limits the lower range that the Velocity Probe 
reaches.  The measurement displayed on the video monitor and in the data 
ranges from 15 to 53 CFM for minimum fan velocity to maximum fan velocity. 
The accuracy is stated to be ±3% of the reading ±1% of the selected range.  This 
is within the required accuracy. 
Inspection of the data acquired and stored in the Experiment Assembly shows 
that 4 samples per second are acquired.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-12 
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION:  11 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):   
REQUIREMENT 
The Flame Radiation shall be measured with an accuracy of 10% of the reading, 
at a sampling rate of 4 Hz, and at a wavelength from visible to near infra-red. 
 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The Flame Radiation measurement will be made by a Thermopile Detector 
made by ORIEL with Model number 71768.  The output is routed to an 
amplifier for scaling and amplification with the output monitored by the A/D 
Converter on the Tattletale board.   
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD:  INS 
Verify that the Radiometer is capable of measuring from visible to near infra-
red. 
 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED – NOT COMPLIANT 
The specification sheet for the Thermopile Detector states that the CAF2 coated 
version present in the SPICE system has a spectral range of 0.13 to 11 µm.  This 
range encompasses the visible and near infrared as required. 
 
The Radiometer is highly susceptible to EMI.  Accurate readings can only be 
done by comparing the value prior to flame initiation and during flame activity. 
 
Inspection of the data acquired and stored in the Experiment Assembly shows 
that 4 samples per second are acquired.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-13 
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION: 12 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):  
REQUIREMENT 
A color video of the flame shall be recorded. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The SPICE hardware consists of a Color CCTV Camera made by Panasonic 
with Model number WV-CP654. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD: TEST 
Perform a functional test per SPICE-TST-006.  The functional test will verify 
that the system records the region of the flame. 
 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
Testing has shown that the flame will be in the field of view.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-14 
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION :  13 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):  
REQUIREMENT 
The field of view of the video image shall include the last 10 mm of the Burner 
Tube to the end of the duct. 
 
IMPLEMENTATION 
This camera is mounted such that its field of view is of the interior of the 
Experiment Assembly. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD: TEST 
Perform an interface and functional test in the MSG engineering unit or similar 
mechanical interface with the SPICE flight hardware.  The functional test will 
verify that the system records the region of interest. 
 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
Testing in the MSG Engineering Unit has shown that the region of interest will 
be in the field of view.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-15 
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION :  14 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):  
REQUIREMENT 
Acquire High Resolution Still images of the Flame.  A maximum of 3 images 
are required per test run. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The SPICE hardware consists of a Nikon D100 Digital SLR Camera.   
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD:  INS 
Perform an inspection of the camera specifications to verify that the camera is of 
sufficient resolution. 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
The Nikon D100 camera is capable of storing the digital images on removable 
disk.  The camera image is a 12-bit RGB CCD with 6 Mpixels.  The camera is 
capable of 3000 x 200, 2240 x 1488, or 1504 x 1000 pixels image size.  These 
specifications clearly shows that the camera is high resolution.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-16 
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION: 15 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):   
REQUIREMENT 
The High resolution color images shall be stored in raw (uncompressed) mode. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
Select a camera that can store files in raw uncompressed format. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD:  INS 
Verify that the NIKON D100 camera can store the images in raw pixel count 
format rather than being compressed into a format such as JPEG. 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
The NIKON D100 camera manual states that the camera is capable of storing 
images in raw format.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-17 
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION: 16 
ERD PARA:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):   
REQUIREMENT 
Fuel flow is adjustable by the crew. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
A potentiometer that will control the set point flow rate of the Mass Flow 
Controller will be available to the crew external to the MSG. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD: TEST 
Perform a functional test per SPICE-TST-006.  The functional test will verify 
that when the Fuel Flow potentiometer is adjusted that the fuel flow rate can be 
adjusted. 
 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
Testing has shown that the fuel flow potentiometer located on the Control Box 
outside the WV allows the crew to change the flow rate.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-18 
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET
VERIFICATION: 17 
ERD PARAGRAPH:  
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):   
REQUIREMENT 
The video science data will be downlinked real-time for the initial runs and prior 
to performing the next series of runs after the initial runs. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The Color Video signal is routed to the MSG facility Monitor and Video 
Recorder.  The MSG facility is capable of downlinking this data as ISS 
bandwidth permits.  The project will submit a resource request for this downlink 
data. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD: INS 
Verify that the ICD includes the resource request. 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
The ICD states:  SPICE experiment video is required to be downlinked as soon 
as possible either during or immediately after each flame test.  The digital 
photos from the SPICE still camera are required to be downlinked as soon as 
possible after selected flame tests for ground confirmation prior to proceeding 
with the following test.

SPICE-RPT-002 
 A-19 
SPICE SCIENCE REQUIREMENT VERIFICATION SHEET 
 
VERIFICATION: 18 
ERD PARAGRAPH: 4.6.1.a.2 
VERIFICATION LEAD(S):   
REQUIREMENT 
Available fuels are methane, propane, ethylene, mixture of 50% propylene and 
50% nitrogen, mixture of 75% propylene and 25% nitrogen, and pure propylene. 
IMPLEMENTATION 
The project will assemble, test, and launch 12 gas bottles with two bottles of 
each type of gas or gas mixture. 
VERIFICATION 
VERIFICATION METHOD:  INS 
Verify that the ICD includes the upmass resource. 
 
VERIFICATION STATUS: CLOSED - COMPLIANT 
The ICD includes Table I which shows 12 bottles in 2 stowage cases.
